about: VIVID 2's own test map (/Game/VIVID2/Maps/TestYard): a flat yard at height 0 with two roads, four box houses and a debris lobe, built from engine shapes by tools/build_testyard.py from this layout and its ground truth. The damage is real geometry: the debris lobe is brown ground with boulders, logs and mounds across road R01; house B02 has a sagging roof and rubble against one wall; house B03 is a rubble pile spilling across road R02. Smoke tests (campaigns/smoke.jsonc, campaigns/smoke_damage.jsonc) and damage-mapper tests run here.
frame: NED metres from the Unreal origin (north = Unreal X, east = Unreal Y); the ground is at 0 (Unreal Z = 0).

debris.about: ground a landslide covered with soil, boulders and broken trees

buildings.cause: earth movement: roof sagging, rubble against the south wall
